title: The local-class edge and its single-complex normalization
statement: Let $g:T\to S$ be a morphism of schemes and $q\in\mathbf Z$, with the shared derived categories of structure-module sheaves [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Set $R=Rg_*$, $F=g_*$, and let $H_X^q$ and $S_X^q$ be cohomology and the complex concentrated in degree $q$. Let $\Theta$, $\lambda$ and $\Theta_{g^{-1}(-)}$ be the local-class, local Leray and inverse-open local-class comparisons of [def-weil-pbc-truncated-counit-edge], computed on its fixed K-injective representatives using [lem-trf-unbounded-direct-image-section-presheaf, lem-pc-ringed-space-sheafification-cohomology]. There exists a family of module maps $e_K:H_S^q(RK)\to F(H_T^qK)$, natural in every derived object $K$, such that on every open $V\subseteq S$ one has $\Theta^{RK}_V\,\Gamma(V,e_K)=\lambda_{g,K,V}\,\Theta^K_{g^{-1}V}$. For every module $M$ on $T$, let $u_{g,q,M}:S_S^q(FM)\to R(S_T^qM)$ be the direct-image single comparison defined in [lem-weil-pbc-integer-single-adjunction-transpose]. Then $H_S^q(u_{g,q,M})$ is invertible and $H_S^q(u_{g,q,M})\,e_{S_T^qM}=E_S(FM)\,F(E_T(M)^{-1})$, where $E_X(N):H_X^q(S_X^qN)\simeq N$ is the standard single/homology identification. This assertion uses no derived pullback, derived adjunction, or truncated counit.

source.place: Tags 079W, 0BKJ and 0D5X; derived.tex Tags 08J5 and 06XS. Agent-derived normalization of the explicit maps.

proof.text: Construct the edge on the fixed K-injective representative from the kernel/cokernel homology edge, transported along the fixed homology identifications. Its naturality is the naturality of these comparisons and of the raw edge.
Use the local-class description of this specified edge to prove the sectionwise identity.

Invertibility of the single direct-image comparison follows from the degree-zero derived unit and integer shifts. The separate kernel/cokernel calculation on a single proves the normalization of the constructed edge. Combine these results with the explicit family to witness all three clauses.

mathlib_searches.results: toSheafify_naturality and sheafifyLift APIs, but no module-linear edge with these fixed local and single comparisons.

mathlib_searches.query: A natural edge from homology of derived direct image to direct image of homology is obtained by sheafifying local cohomology classes and is normalized on single complexes
mathlib_searches.results: homologyFunctorFactors and singleFunctorCompHomologyFunctorIso; no such simultaneous local edge/normalization theorem.

Definitions occur in DerivedAdjunctionTopEdgeData and are used by the parent through the assigned hole. No independent proof of the local module edge. Blueprint cohomology sheafification search found no duplicate.

mathlib_searches.query: For a left exact additive functor F and a complex I there is a natural morphism Hq(F I) to F(Hq I), defined using the kernel cycles and cokernel boundaries
mathlib_searches.results: Functor.preservesHomologyOfExact and preservesHomology_of_map_exact, ShortComplex.HomologyData.map_homologyMap, and mapCyclesIso_hom_naturality. These provide comparison APIs with homology preservation hypotheses; they do not give the module-linear local edge for the generally nonexact direct image together with its fixed local normalization.

from.place: The canonical affine coherent cohomology identification in the 0GKA input to 0GKV(b), used in the classical torsion constructibility input of thm-weil-pbc-direct-image-finiteness-proper; the comparison and its restriction compatibility in steps 4 and 5 of lem-weil-pbc-smooth-curve-etale-structure-direct-images. Identification of the derived map with pullback of local cohomology classes. The top-degree normalization of the derived-to-ordinary module adjoint. Local normalization on the upper truncation of the derived direct image. The local-class edge and its single-complex normalization.
